title: 第201章 抵达武道总盟第200章 六劲合一破母石
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：矿奴开局，八极拳打穿三十六重天第201章：抵达武道总盟（..la）班定远那句“老子倒要看看上古武道联盟在门后面留了什么”还在虚空中回荡，苏意已经踏上了虚空中的裂缝通道。
六劲合一打出的真空通道在母石碎裂后没有立刻消散，裂缝两侧的魂晶波纹层被拳劲冻住了一样静止不动，形成一条笔直的桥。
他走在最前面。
班定远和陈铁柱一左一右跟在后面，两个老头的拳头还攥着没松开。
赵独锋、石敢、何大壮、季长风三人、岳擎天、陈铁山、孟小楼、秦无双——所有人依次踏上裂缝，从遗城边缘走向那片隐藏在虚空深处的古老建筑群。
苏意的草鞋踩上对面地面的瞬间，脚底板传来一种极细微极清晰的触感——不是冷，不是硬，是“认”。
地面铺的石料在感应到他脚底的拳劲后微微发热，像一块沉睡了不知多少年的铁砧终于等到了铁锤。
青金色石料。
不是青石，不是黑铁矿石，不是魂晶母石。
是一种从未见过的材质，石料表面在暗处自行发出极淡极稳的微光，光芒的颜色介于青色和金色之间。
整片广场的地面全用这种石料铺成，每一块石板上都刻着武道拳架图。
八极拳的开门式、形意拳的五行十二形、太极拳的揽雀尾、劈挂拳的通臂劲、咏春拳的寸劲木人桩、八卦掌的拧转步——苏意认识的二十一种国术，全被刻在这片广场上。
不是刻在一块石板上，是每一种国术占据一片区域，拳架图从起手式到收势全套刻满，一幅接一幅铺到视线尽头。
广场正中央立着一座武道石碑。
比武道城那块大了一倍，碑身用同一种青金色石料凿成。
苏意走到碑前，碑面上的六个大字在他人还离着一段距离时就自行亮起——“国术三十六重天”。
亮起的瞬间，整片广场上所有刻着拳架图的石板同时发出极淡极稳的青金色光芒，光芒从苏意脚下往四面八方蔓延，一层一层点亮了整座广场。
矿神在苏意体内把碑文逐字逐句翻译出来。
声音极沉极稳，比之前任何一次都更慢更清楚，像是怕漏掉任何一个字。
“国术三十六重天武道联盟总盟。

凡能踏入此地者，需通过六大流派终极武道禁制考验。
每通过一道禁制，对应的国术流派拳劲将提升至圆满境。
六道全部通过者可开启总盟主传承——武道归宗拳谱全本。
拳谱全本非招式秘籍，乃六劲合一之法则。
持此法则者，可开宗立派，武道称祖。”
班定远站在苏意旁边，仰头看着碑上那六个大字，忽然低低骂了一声。
不是愤怒的骂，是那种在工地上干了几十年见过所有不可能完成的活儿、今天又遇到一个更不可能完成的活儿之后才会发出的骂。
带着笑，带着痛快，带着一种“老子就是来干这个的”的豪气。
广场尽头依次排列着六道禁制。
每一道禁制之间隔了一小段距离，每道禁制前方都有一块空白的青金石板。
第一道是八极拳禁制——一面刻着全套八大招的巨大铁壁，铁壁上撑锤、迎面掌、铁山靠、猛虎硬爬山、左右硬开门、立地通天炮、六合大枪、八极劈山斧，八个拳架凹槽一字排开，每个凹槽都需要用对应的拳劲击打才能激活。
第二道是形意拳禁制——一根悬浮在半空中的金属桩，桩身上刻着劈、崩、钻、炮、横五种崩拳的发力方向，五道刻痕在桩身正中央交汇成一个极深的拳印凹槽，需要五种崩拳劲同时打在同一落点才能击碎。
第三道是太极拳禁制——一潭死水，水面平静如镜，水质清澈见底但看不到潭底，水面上没有一丝波纹，需要以化劲在水面上打出一拳而水面不破。
第四道是劈挂拳禁制——一条悬在虚空中的铁索，铁索从广场边缘延伸到虚空深处，索身被风吹得微微晃动，索正中央有一个极小的金属节点，需要以鞭劲甩拳击中那个节点。
第五道是咏春拳禁制——一面嵌满了活动木人桩的墙壁，桩臂正在以极快的速度交错伸缩，木桩的三条手臂和一条腿同时活动，轨迹交织成一片密集到几乎看不清的棍影，需要以寸劲在木人桩手臂收回的瞬间同时击中所有木人桩的核心。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Mine Slave Begins, Baji Fist Penetrates the Thirty-Six Heavens Chapter 201: Arriving at the General Martial Arts Alliance (..la) Ban Dingyuan's words "I want to see what the ancient Martial Arts Alliance left behind the door" are still echoing in the void, and Su Yi has already stepped onto the crack passage in the void.
The vacuum channel created by the combination of the six powers did not dissipate immediately after the mother stone was shattered. The rippled layers of soul crystals on both sides of the crack remained motionless as if frozen by the fist power, forming a straight bridge.
He was at the front.
Ban Dingyuan and Chen Tiezhu followed behind, the two old men still clenching their fists.
Zhao Dufeng, Shi Gan, He Dazhuang, Ji Changfeng, Yue Qingtian, Chen Tieshan, Meng Xiaolou, Qin Wushuang—all of them stepped onto the cracks in turn, walking from the edge of the ruined city towards the ancient buildings hidden deep in the void.
The moment Su Yi's straw sandals stepped on the ground opposite, a very subtle and clear touch came from the soles of his feet - not cold, not hard, but "recognition".
The stone paved on the ground warmed slightly after sensing the force of his foot's fist, like an anvil that had been sleeping for countless years and finally waited for the hammer.
Lazuli gold stone.
Not bluestone, not black iron ore, not soul crystal mother stone.
It is a material that has never been seen before. The surface of the stone emits a very light and steady shimmer in the dark. The color of the light is between cyan and gold.
The ground of the entire square is paved with this kind of stone, and every stone slab is engraved with a diagram of a martial arts boxing frame.
The open-door stance of Bajiquan, the Five Elements and Twelve Shapes of Xingyiquan, the Bird's Tail of Tai Chi, the through-arm strength of Piguaquan, the inch-strength wooden dummy of Wing Chun, and the twisting step of Baguazhang - twenty-one kinds of Chinese martial arts that Su Yi knew were all engraved on this square.
Instead of being engraved on a single stone slab, each martial art occupies an area. The entire set of boxing diagrams from the starting position to the closing position is engraved, one after another, spread out to the end of the line of sight.
In the center of the square stands a martial arts monument.
It is twice as big as the one in Martial Arts City, and the body of the monument is made of the same green-gold stone.
Su Yi walked to the monument. The six characters on the monument lit up on their own while others were still some distance away - "The Thirty-sixth Level of National Martial Arts".
The moment it lit up, all the stone slabs with boxing pictures engraved on the entire square simultaneously emitted a very light and stable blue-gold light. The light spread from Su Yi's feet in all directions, lighting up the entire square layer by layer.
The Mine God translated the inscription word for word in Su Yi's body.
His voice was extremely deep and steady, slower and clearer than ever before, as if he was afraid of missing any word.
“The General Alliance of the Thirty-Sixth Level of National Martial Arts and Heavenly Martial Arts Alliance.
Anyone who can step into this place must pass the ultimate martial arts prohibition test of the six major schools.
Each time a ban is passed, the corresponding martial arts school's boxing strength will be raised to perfection.
Those who pass all six paths can open the inheritance of the general leader - the complete book of martial arts Guizong Fist Book.
The complete boxing manual is not a secret book of moves, but the law of the unification of six powers.
Those who adhere to this rule can establish a sect and become the ancestors of martial arts. "
Ban Dingyuan stood next to Su Yi, looking up at the six characters on the monument, and suddenly cursed in a low voice.
It's not an angry scolding, it's the kind of scolding that comes out after having worked on construction sites for decades and seeing all impossible jobs, and today I encountered an even more impossible job.
With a smile, with joy, with a kind of heroic spirit that "I am here to do this".
At the end of the square, there are six prohibitions arranged in sequence.
There is a small distance between each restriction, and there is a blank lapis lazuli slab in front of each restriction.
The first one is the Bajiquan restriction - a huge iron wall engraved with a full set of eight moves. On the iron wall are the supporting hammer, the face palm, the iron mountain support, the tiger hard climb, the left and right hard doors, the sky-reaching cannon, the Liuhe big gun, and the eight-ji mountain-splitting axe. The eight boxing grooves are lined up, and each groove needs to be hit with the corresponding punch to activate.
The second is the Xingyiquan prohibition - one hangingA metal pile floating in mid-air. The pile is engraved with the five force directions of the Beng Fist: splitting, collapsing, drilling, cannon, and horizontal. The five notches intersect in the center of the pile to form a very deep fist mark groove. It requires the five Beng Fist powers to hit the same impact point at the same time to break it.
The third level is Tai Chi prohibition - a pool of stagnant water, the water surface is as calm as a mirror, the water quality is crystal clear but the bottom of the pool cannot be seen, there is no ripple on the water surface, and one needs to use one's strength to punch on the water surface without breaking the water surface.
The fourth one is the Piguaquan Restriction - an iron rope hanging in the void. The iron rope extends from the edge of the square to the depths of the void. The rope body is slightly swayed by the wind. There is a very small metal node in the center of the rope. You need to hit that node with a whip and a fist.
The fifth path is the Wing Chun ban - a wall embedded with movable wooden dummies. The arms of the wooden dummies are extending and retracting at a very fast speed. The three arms and one leg of the wooden dummy move at the same time, and the trajectory is intertwined into a dense shadow of sticks that is almost invisible. It requires an inch of strength to hit the core of all the wooden dummies at the same time when the arms of the wooden dummy are retracted.
